title: Implement request-directory discovery and asset loading
objective: Resolve a safe request name beneath configured requestsDirectory, discover recognized assets, parse contents, and report bounded configuration failures before completion. Contract sections: requests/README.md#request-bundle-layout; requests/README.md#asset-mapping-and-optionality; requests/README.md#processing-order; requests/README.md#request-name-and-filesystem-safety. Explicit human operator confirmation is required before modifying requests/README.md.

branch.name: llm-request-lookup
branch.rationale: The record captures bounded planning without creating or switching a branch.

request.text: Prepare small, testable work items for dynamic request lookup: document requests/README.md; support request asset discovery; schema-aware CLI parameters including dot/index paths and --parameters JSON; $${variableName}$$ substitution; completeRequest({ requestName, parameters, files, ... }); llm req CLI integration; raw/full output; summarize compatibility; provider-free validation.

scope.name: safe-resolution
scope.description: A request name resolves only to a safe child directory beneath configured requestsDirectory.

scope.name: asset-set
scope.description: The loader recognizes exactly one task source (prompt.md or task.json), an optional system prompt, defaults, schemas, and bounded asset alternatives as defined by requests/README.md#asset-mapping-and-optionality.
scope.reason: Every request property needs one deterministic source.

scope.name: parsing-errors
scope.description: Malformed or wrong-shaped assets fail with bounded errors identifying request and asset kind.
scope.reason: Invalid configuration must stop before completion.

scope.name: configuration-reuse
scope.description: Configured requestsDirectory continues using the existing shared boundary.
scope.reason: Users must not receive command-specific lookup behavior.

scope.name: authoritative-contract
scope.description: Implement only the authoritative contract sections [Request bundle layout](#request-bundle-layout), [Asset mapping and optionality](#asset-mapping-and-optionality), [Processing order](#processing-order), [Request-name and filesystem safety](#request-name-and-filesystem-safety). Do not modify requests/README.md without explicit human operator confirmation.
scope.reason: The request README is the source of truth for this implementation batch.

nonGoals.name: implementation
nonGoals.description: Do not implement behavior outside this work item.

nonGoals.name: provider-and-release
nonGoals.description: Do not make authenticated calls, publish, deploy, or claim production readiness.

nonGoals.name: unrelated-refactor
nonGoals.description: Do not redesign unrelated commands, providers, schemas, or persistence.
nonGoals.reason: Scope is limited to dynamic request lookup.

items.name: safe-resolution
items.description: A request name resolves only to a safe child directory beneath configured requestsDirectory.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Valid names resolve beneath the configured root.
Absolute names, traversal, separators, symlinked directories, and missing directories fail before asset reads.

items.name: asset-set
items.description: The loader recognizes exactly one task source (prompt.md or task.json), an optional system prompt, defaults, schemas, and additional input boundaries as defined by requests/README.md#asset-mapping-and-optionality.
items.reason: Every request property needs one deterministic source.

acceptanceCriteria.description: All recognized assets and the mutually exclusive task-source alternatives are discovered with stable required/optional representation.
Unknown or ambiguous asset names follow an explicit rule.

items.name: parsing-errors
items.description: Malformed or wrong-shaped assets fail with bounded errors identifying request and asset kind.
items.reason: Invalid configuration must stop before completion.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Malformed JSON, non-object schemas, unreadable assets, and invalid asset types fail before provider invocation.

items.name: configuration-reuse
items.description: Configured requestsDirectory continues using the existing shared boundary.
items.reason: Users must not receive command-specific lookup behavior.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Application/home/environment precedence and missing guidance remain covered.
